'''Primal Dragon Armor''' was a {{Legendary}} [[Armor]] set. {{Skill|Combat|26}} was required to use it and, if the item was dungeonised, {{Skill|Catacombs|16}} to use it while in [[Dungeons]].

== Obtaining ==
'''Primal Dragon Armor''' pieces dropped from a {{MobSprite|Primal Dragon}}. A randomly selected piece had a {{Chance|30%|1|3.33}} chance to drop if the player met the [[Ender Dragon#Drops|Dragon Weight]] requirement.

When '''Primal Dragon Armor''' was obtained as loot from a {{MobSprite|Primal Dragon}}, it was always [[Recombobulator 3000|Recombobulated]].
